variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No token yet: the heading stays and a flush card with an EmptyState and Create Personal Token replaces the controls row and the table.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the controls row and the table shell with its loading rows, before the empty state can be decided.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The list could not load: a danger Alert with Retry in place of the table; Retry loads the tokens.

variants.name: Created
variants.summary: Right after Create: the one-time reveal Dialog with the warning, the masked secret with show and copy, and a confirmation that the token was copied.
